main.description: Project one or more rows from vertex_legal_entity into vertex_contracts_organization. Reactive entry-point: legal-entity commits and cron backfill both call this. Enriches with social-contract entity DID and idempotent-upserts to Hyperdrive.

sourceRecordId.description: source_record_id on vertex_legal_entity (e.g. NTA houjin-bangou / GLEIF LEI / OpenCorporates id). Mutually exclusive with lei/vertexId.

batchLimit.description: When none of sourceRecordId/lei/vertexId given, run backfill projecting up to this many unprojected rows (default 500, max 5000)

dids.description: Organization DIDs of newly projected rows
